inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving a specific user by their UUID.

uuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the user. Alternatively, use the literal string "me" to refer to the currently authenticated user (the caller). Defaults to "me" (current user) if not specified.
uuid.title: Uuid
